purpose: Read-only repackage of immutable completed original artifacts; no rerun, retiming, source change, gate change, or observation replacement
pendingPolicy: Record cells whose artifact is unavailable when inventory runs. Do not wait or occupy a runner for pending source jobs. A later explicit request nonce may export newly completed IDs.
retentionPolicy: Verify original published ZIP size and SHA-256; retain its full entry manifest and every qualification file, including raw failed memory receipts, semantic scans, packages, logs, and source/harness identities. Omit only reproducible qualification-sources worktrees.
